blocks.text: The inclined wedge separates and lifts the mattress 4-5 inches as it is inserted between the mattress and box spring. items.value: COMPATIBILITY CHECK – Please note that this device will not work with mattresses on a bed frame that has a high lip or raised edge or has slats for the boxspring. Mattress must lay flat.
